primary_endpoint: For each of four arms: whether any emitted tool name is not in the actual dispatcher; also report total counts and denominators.
secondary_endpoints: schema-valid calls and actual successful/failed tool responses
presence-only loss of named bed/work/dining/storage roles; not complete usability
same independent final-mesh surface witnesses and collision pairs as v1
actual token, generation time, wall time and peak GPU memory
comparison_reference: P920-DD-v1_20261104T083214Z, saved same-arm seed-0 outputs; no reruns or replacement samples
unit_of_analysis: One development room. Four related arms are not four independent projects.
statistics: Descriptive paired outcomes only; no p-values, generalization or learning-superiority claim.
zero_action_policy: An empty program is reported as no action, never rewarded as a successful repair merely because it has no invalid calls.
failure_policy: Preserve all attempts; do not retry, choose alternative seeds or add model continuations. Evaluate retained drafts for rejected programs.
